PowerShell($c = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 4321 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($c\) { $c.OwningProcess | Select-Object -Unique | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "Stopping PID $_"; Stop-Process -Id $_ -Force } } else { Write-Output "No dev server on 4321" })

PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 6; try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:4321/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 15; Write-Output "home: $\($r.StatusCode\)" } catch { Write-Output "home err: $\($_.Exception.Message\)" }; try { $r2 = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:4321/invite" -UseBasicParsing -MaximumRedirection 0 -TimeoutSec 15; Write-Output "invite: $\($r2.StatusCode\)" } catch { Write-Output "invite status: $\($_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__\)" })

PowerShell(try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:4321/invite" -UseBasicParsing -MaximumRedirection 0 -TimeoutSec 15 } catch { Write-Output "invite -> $\($_.Exception.Response.StatusCode.value__\) \(redirect to login = gated OK\)" }; try { $h = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:4321/" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 15; Write-Output "home -> $\($h.StatusCode\)" } catch { Write-Output "home err $\($_.Exception.Message\)" })
